_provenance.fix_capacity_count:
capacity_loss.count was 488 = max_potential - final_manifested, i.e. ALL missed orders rather than the capacity cut alone. The page rendered 'Orders Missed in Capacity Cut −188' in the waterfall and '488' in the panel ten lines below, and the inflated figure flowed into _compose_load_status's 'biggest single loss is a capacity cut' sentence.
Correcting it to |bar4_value| = 188 alone made allocation_miss (300) DOMINANT, which destroys this fixture's only purpose — it is the capacity-cut-dominant case, the one that exercises the negative bar4 sign. So allocation_miss was lowered to 120 and the waterfall recomputed to keep the identity exact: 890 - 120 = 770; 770 - 188 = 582. Capacity (188) now genuinely dominates allocation (120), and total missed (308) equals max - final (308).
